author: Comics Explained
description:
▸ Black Cat is a character appearing in American comic books published by Marvel Comics. Created by Marv Wolfman and Dave Cockrum, the character first appeared in The Amazing Spider-Man issue 194 in July 1979 as an adversary of the superhero Spider-Man, although she later becomes his on-off love interest and ally.
